what: crates/load-cargo/src/v2/files.rs Mounts::node (lines 103-107): it calls `self.tree.list(root, &under)` (blaze-query Tree::list, which copies every name of the directory into owned Strings) only to learn whether the path is a directory. Replace with `return Ok(match self.tree.read_dir(root, &under, &mut |_| {}) { true => Node::Dir(path), false => Node::None });` (Tree::read_dir returns whether it is a directory and lends the names without copying). Why: node runs for every path read that is not a file, and for every symlink a walk follows; each made one Vec and one String per name of the directory, now none. Same answer: read_dir is false exactly when list is None (blaze-query tree.rs Tree::list is built on read_dir).
